/* Tbm04Mapper.selectHistorySessionList */ SELECT A.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , ST.SITE_NM AS siteNm , A.TITLE AS title , A.STATUS_CD AS statusCd , SC.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS statusNm , A.MANAGER_USER_CD AS managerUserCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.MANAGER_USER_CD, NULL) AS managerUserNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.OPENED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS openedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.STARTED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS startedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.ENDED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS endedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS insertDate /* 연계 위험성평가 수 */ , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_RISK R WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND R.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD ) AS riskCount /* 출결 집계(출결 테이블 미사용 단계에서는 0). DEL_YN='N' 기준 */ , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT WHERE AT.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND AT.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS attendanceCount , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT WHERE AT.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND AT.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'COMPLETED' ) AS completedCount , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT WHERE AT.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND AT.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'NOT_COMPLETED' ) AS notCompletedCount FROM TB_TBM_SESSION A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE ST ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = ST.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = ST.SITE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT D.SYST_VAL_D_CD, D.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D D WHERE D.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS046' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ) SC ON ( A.STATUS_CD = SC.SYST_VAL_D_CD )
/* 종료일(없으면 등록일) 최신순 */ ORDER BY IFNULL(A.ENDED_AT, A.INSERT_DATE) DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

/* Tbm04Mapper.selectHistoryStat */ /* 필터된 세션 집합(A)에 출결(AT)을 LEFT JOIN 하여 한 번에 집계. 출결 0건이면 모두 0. */ /* SUM은 행이 0건이면 NULL을 반환하므로 IFNULL로 0 보정(결과 record가 primitive int) */ SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT A.SESSION_CD) AS sessionCount , COUNT(AT.ATTENDANCE_CD) AS attendanceCount , IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completedCount , IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'NOT_COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS notCompletedCount FROM TB_TBM_SESSION A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = AT.CMPNY_CD AND A.SESSION_CD = AT.SESSION_CD AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' )

/* Tbm04Mapper.selectAttendanceEvents */ SELECT EV.EVENT_NO AS eventNo , EV.EVENT_TYPE_CD AS eventTypeCd , ET.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS eventTypeNm , DATE_FORMAT(EV.EVENT_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS eventTime , DATE_FORMAT(EV.SERVER_RECEIVED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS serverReceivedAt , EV.EVENT_DATA AS eventData FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE_EVENT EV LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT D.SYST_VAL_D_CD, D.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D D WHERE D.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS054' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ) ET ON ( EV.EVENT_TYPE_CD = ET.SYST_VAL_D_CD ) WHERE EV.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND EV.ATTENDANCE_CD = #{attendanceCd} ORDER BY EV.EVENT_TIME, EV.EVENT_NO LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

/* Tbm04Mapper.selectAttendanceGuard */ SELECT AT.ATTENDANCE_CD AS attendanceCd , AT.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , S.SITE_CD AS siteCd , S.MANAGER_USER_CD AS managerUserCd , AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD AS completionStatusCd FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION S ON ( AT.CMPNY_CD = S.CMPNY_CD AND AT.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD ) WHERE AT.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND AT.ATTENDANCE_CD = #{attendanceCd} AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N'

/* Tbm04Mapper.selectUserAttendances */ SELECT AT.ATTENDANCE_CD AS attendanceCd , AT.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , S.TITLE AS sessionTitle , S.SITE_CD AS siteCd , ST.SITE_NM AS siteNm , DATE_FORMAT(IFNULL(S.ENDED_AT, S.INSERT_DATE), '%Y-%m-%d') AS sessionDate , DATE_FORMAT(AT.ENTRY_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS entryAt , DATE_FORMAT(AT.EXIT_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS exitAt , AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD AS completionStatusCd , CS.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS completionStatusNm , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_RISK R WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = S.CMPNY_CD AND R.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD ) AS riskCount FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION S ON ( AT.CMPNY_CD = S.CMPNY_CD AND AT.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE ST ON ( S.CMPNY_CD = ST.CMPNY_CD AND S.SITE_CD = ST.SITE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT D.SYST_VAL_D_CD, D.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D D WHERE D.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS053' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ) CS ON ( AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = CS.SYST_VAL_D_CD )
ORDER BY IFNULL(S.ENDED_AT, S.INSERT_DATE) DESC, AT.ATTENDANCE_CD DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
/* Tbm04Mapper.selectUserAttendanceCount */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION S ON ( AT.CMPNY_CD = S.CMPNY_CD AND AT.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD )

/* Tbm04Mapper.selectUserAttendanceSummary */ /* SUM은 행이 0건이면 NULL을 반환하므로 IFNULL로 0 보정(결과 record가 primitive int) */ SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalCount , IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completedCount , IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'NOT_COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS notCompletedCount /* 평균 참여시간(분): 입실~종료가 모두 있는 출결 기준. 없으면 NULL */ , ROUND(AVG( CASE WHEN AT.ENTRY_AT IS NOT NULL AND AT.EXIT_AT IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, AT.ENTRY_AT, AT.EXIT_AT) ELSE NULL END )) AS avgDurationMin FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION S ON ( AT.CMPNY_CD = S.CMPNY_CD AND AT.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD )
